ev_m_closure_r234.product_fix: Lite: engine/expLogSimplify.ts applies exp(k*log r) = r^k exactly for integer k (|k| <= 400) and positive rational r with a bounded BigInt product; engine/logSimplify.ts reduces log(a-sqrt(b))+log(a+sqrt(b)) to 0 exactly for conjugate radical pairs with a>0 and a^2-b = 1; engine/parsing/index.ts reads a local one-variable definition followed by its call, accepting \left/\right and balanced parentheses in the argument.
